name: landing-page-gradient-tokens
hook: Add CSS var gradient tokens before using them in components
body:
Landing page gradient colors (#0ea5e9, #a855f7, #0284c7, #9333ea, etc.) must be defined as CSS variables in globals.css before they can be used in client components. Do not inline hardcoded gradient strings in JSX.

Why: CLAUDE.md design system rule requires all colors to be defined as design tokens first. Hardcoded gradients bypass the token system and violate the rule.

How to apply: When adding new landing page gradients, add --gradient-* CSS vars in globals.css light theme block first, then reference them as var(--gradient-*) in components.
why: PR #171 review flagged hardcoded gradients in NewStartPage as a design system violation. Future landing page work should follow the token-first pattern.
